title.rendered: Update – Events Cancelled on Friday, September 11, 2020

content.rendered:
With the ongoing unhealthy air quality conditions, continuing with this week’s scheduled outdoor events has become a safety hazard for our students and families attending the events, as well as for staff working outside for prolonged periods of time.  As a result, all school events across the District scheduled for Friday, September 11 — including drive-through events, supply pick-ups, and technology distribution — are cancelled.  Athletics practices will remain cancelled until further notice. 

Please stay tuned for more information about continued supply and technology distribution. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we tend to the safety and health of all.
